channel.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Western Sahara Resource Watch (wsrw.org)

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | New report: Greenwashing Occupation
item.description: Out now: WSRW today publishes a new report outlining the massive - and deeply problematic - renewable energy projects that Morocco is developing in occupied Western Sahara.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | Certification giant SGS points fingers elsewhere
item.description: SGS blames everyone else for mistakes on MarinTrust certificates it had issued to Moroccan companies in occupied Western Sahara.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | New report: Certified occupation
item.description: International certification standards embellish Morocco’s controversial trade with fisheries and agricultural products in occupied Western Sahara, new report documents.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | Greenland Yes, Western Sahara No? The EU’s self-determination test
item.description: As the European Union rightly rallies behind Greenlanders’ right to decide their own future in the face of external pressure, a test of the EU’s real commitment to self-determination is quietly unfolding in Brussels.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | EU-Morocco Statement: autonomy without self-determination, law without lawfulness
item.description: A joint statement that came out of last week’s EU-Morocco Association Council asks readers to believe in a fiction: that an undefined autonomy plan imposed by an occupying power can satisfy the right to self-determination, and that respect for international law can coexist with the systematic ignoring of the EU’s own highest court.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | TAQA-Moeve obtains land in occupied Western Sahara
item.description: Morocco’s push for green hydrogen has taken a decisive step forward - on territory it does not legally own.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | US eyes minerals in occupied Western Sahara
item.description: Seeking to position itself as a key supplier of strategic minerals for Western powers, Morocco has signed a new agreement with the United States that covers Western Sahara’s waters and the critical minerals harboured there.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | Morocco allocates land in occupied Western Sahara to green hydrogen investors
item.description: Morocco’s ambitions to become a global green hydrogen powerhouse are accelerating. Yet, Rabat is allocating land in a territory it does not legally own.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | Siemens Energy sidesteps key questions on Western Sahara
item.description: At its 2026 Annual General Meeting, Siemens Energy defended its involvement in wind energy projects in occupied Western Sahara.

item.title: Western Sahara Resource Watch | MEPs push back on Commission over Western Sahara in EU–Morocco trade
item.description: MEPs from across the political spectrum sharply criticised the European Commission over its handling of EU-Morocco trade relations covering occupied Western Sahara, raising concerns over legality, transparency and an apparent disregard for Parliament’s role.
